title: Temperature log
description: A pixel temperature log: enter a reading in degrees Celsius and add it to a list, show the minimum, maximum and average of all readings, and a Clear button.

title: Quiz maker
description: A pixel quiz maker: type a question and its yes/no answer to add a card, then a Play mode asks each card in order, counts correct answers and shows the final score.

title: Event countdown
description: A pixel countdown: enter minutes and seconds, Start counts down once per second in a big mm:ss display, Pause and Reset buttons, and a 'Time's up!' message at zero.

title: Shopping list
description: A pixel shopping list: add an item with a quantity, tick items as bought (bought items move to the bottom and are struck through), show how many items remain, and a Clear bought button.

title: Coin flipper
description: A pixel coin flipper: a Flip button shows heads or tails, count heads and tails separately, show the current streak of the same side, and a Reset button.

title: Grade calculator
description: A pixel grade calculator: add courses with a name, credit hours and a letter grade (A, B, C, D, F), show the list and the credit-weighted GPA on a 4.0 scale.

title: Light puzzle
description: A pixel lights-out puzzle on a 3x3 grid: clicking a cell toggles it and its up, down, left and right neighbours, count moves, show a win message when all lights are off, and a New puzzle button.

title: Word counter
description: A pixel word counter: a text area, live counts of words, characters and sentences, the estimated reading time at 200 words per minute, and a Clear button.
